title: 2020 HMMT February Guts Problem 1
statement: Submit an integer \(x\) as your answer to this problem. The number of points you receive will be \(\max (0,8-|8 x-100|)\). (Non-integer answers will be given 0 points.)

solutions.text: We want to minimize \(|8 x-100|\), so \(x\) should equal either the floor or the ceiling of \(\frac{100}{8}=12.5\). Note that no other answers receive any points, while both 12 and 13 receive 4 points.
